title: Naturality of normalized integral compact-support compositor components
statement: The normalized integral compact-support compositor components commute with every morphism of integral constructible inputs.

proof.text: Use a common compatible refining tower for the two inputs. Naturality of the open unit, proper counit, adjunct Gamma, composition maps, normalized refinements and Roos realization comparisons gives equality after transport to the completed category. Faithfulness of the constructible inclusion yields the displayed equation.
